title.zh: 【路透社：德意志银行数周内将在德国推出加密托管服务，明年拓展至亚洲】
title.en: 【路透社：德意志银行数周内将在德国推出加密托管服务，明年拓展至亚洲】

current_state.zh:
德意志银行企业银行业务联席主管 Gerald Podobnik 向路透社表示，该行将在数周内在德国推出数字资产托管服务，初期支持 BTC、ETH 等主流加密资产，之后再提供主流稳定币的出入金服务。该行计划明年将这一托管平台拓展至亚洲金融中心，并另行推出代币化存款、协助客户发行数字债券等基于区块链的证券。

作为德国最大银行，德意志银行推出托管服务将为欧洲机构持有 BTC、ETH 增加一个受监管的托管渠道，而其公布的路线图不止于托管，还延伸至代币化存款和基于区块链的债券发行。该服务仍需监管批准，该行此前表示预计将依据 MiCA 获得授权。

该服务分阶段推进：先托管 BTC、ETH 及 USDC、EURC、EURAU 等部分稳定币，随后提供法币与稳定币之间的兑换服务。Podobnik 称此举服务于该行到 2028 年公司银行业务年复合增长 8% 的目标；有报道将亚洲扩张的时间点表述为 2027 年而非“明年”，且未说明具体瞄准哪些亚洲金融中心。
current_state.en: Deutsche Bank says it will launch a digital asset custody service in Germany within weeks, initially covering BTC and ETH with stablecoin on/off-ramp services to follow, and plans to expand the platform to Asian financial centres next year alongside tokenized deposits and blockchain-based digital bond issuance.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Deutsche Bank says it will launch a digital asset custody service in Germany within weeks, initially covering BTC and ETH with stablecoin on/off-ramp services to follow, and plans to expand the platform to Asian financial centres next year alongside tokenized deposits and blockchain-based digital bond issuance.
updates.background_zh: 德意志银行曾于 2023 年 9 月与加密基础设施平台 Taurus 合作，为其托管计划提供支持。Cointelegraph 报道称，欧洲证券和市场管理局的 MiCA 临时登记册显示该行已获得德国联邦金融监管局（BaFin）的授权，并援引该行发言人称预计 10 月获得托管业务的批准。代币化存款是以可编程账本记录的银行负债，仍受现行审慎监管及反洗钱、KYC 规则约束；基于区块链的债券则使用分布式账本技术记录和管理债务证券。
updates.background_en: Deutsche Bank partnered with crypto infrastructure platform Taurus in September 2023 to support its custody plans. Cointelegraph reported that the European Securities and Markets Authority's interim MiCA register showed the bank received authorization from Germany's BaFin, and that a bank spokesperson said it expected approval for the custody offering in October. Tokenized deposits are bank liabilities recorded on programmable ledgers and remain subject to existing prudential and AML/KYC rules, while blockchain-based bonds use distributed ledger technology to record and manage debt securities.
updates.market_impact_zh: 德意志银行的入场为德国机构持有 BTC、ETH 增加了一个银行级、受 MiCA 授权的托管对手方；其计划的亚洲扩张与稳定币出入金服务，将把这一托管渠道连接到更多交易场所和法币—稳定币流动性。代币化存款和数字债券计划则使该行进入银行主导的代币化赛道，与基于稳定币的结算形成部分重叠。
updates.market_impact_en: Deutsche Bank's entry adds a bank-grade, MiCA-authorized custody counterparty for institutional BTC and ETH exposure in Germany, and the planned Asian expansion plus stablecoin on/off-ramps would link that custody channel to additional venues and fiat-stablecoin liquidity. The tokenized deposit and digital bond plans place the bank in the bank-led tokenization segment that overlaps with stablecoin-based settlement.
